messages:
maria: FYI I opened a PR for the user_events snapshot migration and backfill — needs 2 infra approvals + DB signoff before we merge. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4823 :eyes:

sam: taking a look now. quick overview of what it does?

maria: short: create user_events_v2 (new schema with event_type normalized), run backfill job in batches (4k rows/batch) for the past 2 weeks, swap the view, then deprecate old table after 7 days. No downtime intended.

leo: can you paste the migration SQL here? want to check locking/long txs. :thumbsup:

maria: sure — snippet below:
```sql
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE user_events_v2 (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, user_id uuid, event_type text, payload jsonb, created_at timestamptz);
INSERT INTO user_events_v2 (id, user_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
  SELECT id, user_id, CASE WHEN type = 'x' THEN 'x_normalized' ELSE type END, payload, created_at
  FROM user_events
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
  LIMIT 4000; -- batching done in job loop
COMMIT;
```

anya: main concerns: backfill job must use small txs and not touch the whole table. also need indexes on new table before heavy writes. PR mentions `CREATE INDEX ON user_events_v2 (user_id, created_at)` but i think we should create them concurrently.

sam: agree with anya. create indexes concurrently to avoid locking. also add `statement_timeout` for the backfill worker.

maria: good call — i'll update the PR to create indexes concurrently and add throttling config for the backfill job.

leo: @db_bot can you confirm if we need a maintenance window for the view swap? swapping a view is cheap but just want to be sure.

db_bot: db_bot: Quick note — view swap is atomic but if apps still write to old table via direct inserts you need to update writers. Recommend short maintenance window (10m) and run health-checks post-swap.

devops: who will run the backfill job and monitor? we should schedule on a low-traffic slot.

maria: i can kick off the backfill and watch logs. proposing Sat 02:00 UTC. will post runbook in the PR.

sam: LGTM pending the concurrent index change and the runbook steps. added :eyes: review on the PR.

anya: approved after index + timeout changes. left one tiny comment on the dead-letter handling for failed rows.

leo: approved. one more nit: increase batch sleep to 250ms during peak hours.

maria: thanks all — updated PR with changes and added runbook. @devops please add the migration run to the maintenance calendar for Sat 02:00 UTC.

devops: added. deploy-bot will post a reminder 24h and 1h before the window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Migration job scheduled: 2025-08-16 02:00 UTC — PR #4823. Participants: maria, sam, anya, leo, devops.

maria: merging tomorrow barring any last-minute issues. thanks for the quick reviews! :tada:
